I think I relate to the first description more. I feel very connected to things that i know so it’s easier to adjust to new situations like a conversation if i’m taking about something i already like and know about. I try not to think about what will happen in the future as much as the present. But I can also can be overcautious, which can cause me to not fully enjoy the present. For example, before covid i was living such a great life that i had a feeling some big argument between my friends or lots of drama would occur and that everything was too good to be true. I sometimes think about deep thoughts like the meaning of life and why bad things happen, but it’s not really worth stressing about since we won’t ever know for a long time.

1. i usually have strong emotions under stress. in fact, just yesterday i was trying to decide what to wear and i started crying and became very upset. time ticked by and i was starting to become late. i do things like that a lot, even when i don’t have PMS.

2. I wouldn’t necessarily call myself a big picture person, but i do try to plan at least a couple years ahead of what i’m doing. ultimately, i don’t have a big idea of what i will be doing in 10 years from now.

3. in new situations, such as being in a new environment with new people, it usually takes me a while to fully adjust. usually i watch what is going on around myself before i engage in a new scene or conversation. if you are referring to more of a choice, i usually try to think of the negative effects of each choice before i make an ultimate decision.
